item.title: Sierra Nevada Gold Wins Tender for Advanced As Safra project in Saudi Arabia
item.description: Sierra Nevada Gold (ASX: SNX) has been awarded the highly prospective As Safra copper-gold project in Saudi Arabia after a competitive tender process with Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources.

item.title: Marmota Completes Stage 2 Drilling at Greenewood Gold Discovery
item.description: Marmota (ASX: MEU) has successfully completed Stage 2 of its maiden drilling program at the Greenewood gold discovery in South Australia's Gawler Craton, after expanding the program beyond the original plans.

item.title: Golden Globe Resources Commences Diamond Drilling at Dooloo Creek’s Northern Gold Prospect
item.description: Golden Globe Resources (ASX: GGR) has commenced diamond drilling at the Northern Gold prospect within its Dooloo Creek gold-copper project in Queensland, with drill contractor Central Deep Hole Drilling starting operations last week.

item.title: SportsHero Reports Early Indonesian Subscriber Growth for HeroPlay Gaming Platform
item.description: SportsHero (ASX: SHO) has reported early subscriber growth for its recently launched HeroPlay mobile casual gaming platform in Indonesia, confirming strong consumer appetite for the product.

item.title: Lincoln Minerals to Further Investigate SMR Graphite Opportunities for Kookaburra Project
item.description: Lincoln Minerals (ASX: LML) has identified a potential opportunity to supply graphite from its Kookaburra project in South Australia to the growing global nuclear small modular reactor market.

item.title: Brazilian Critical Minerals Produces High-Grade Mixed Rare Earth Carbonate from Ema Project
item.description: Brazilian Critical Minerals (ASX: BCM) has produced a high-grade mixed rare earth carbonate during in-situ recovery field trials at the Ema ionic adsorbed clay rare earth project in Brazil.

item.title: EcoGraf and AngloGold Ashanti Reach Tanzanian Farm-In Milestone for Golden Eagle Project
item.description: EcoGraf (ASX: EGR) has reached a key milestone for a farm-in agreement with global mining giant AngloGold Ashanti through the granting of prospecting licences for the Golden Eagle project in Tanzania.

item.title: Island Pharmaceuticals and Texas Biomed to Conduct Non-Human Primate Studies Using Antiviral Drug Galidesivir
item.description: Island Pharmaceuticals (ASX: ILA) has secured a master service agreement with Texas Biomedical Research Institute to support the development of lead antiviral molecule galidesivir.

item.title: Almonty Begins Commercial Mining at Sangdong Tungsten Mine in South Korea
item.description: Almonty Industries (ASX: AII) has successfully delivered the first truckload of ore to the run-of-mine pad at its Sangdong mine in South Korea, marking a pivotal transition from early-stage mine development to active mining operations.

item.title: Alicanto Minerals To Acquire Mt Henry Gold Project from Westgold Resources
item.description: Alicanto Minerals (ASX: AQI) has confirmed it will acquire the Mt Henry project in Western Australia from Westgold Resources (ASX: WGX), giving it access to a large, near-surface gold system with substantial growth potential.
